```{python}
import fig_den as den
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

den.style()
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": ["Calibri", "Carlito", "DejaVu Sans"],
    "font.size": 12, "axes.labelsize": 12, "xtick.labelsize": 12,
    "ytick.labelsize": 12, "legend.fontsize": 12,
    "axes.grid": False, "axes.spines.left": False,
})


def end_label(ax, x, y, colour, fmt="{:.1f}"):
    """Value of the last point in a box of the series colour, as in DEN decks."""
    ax.annotate(fmt.format(y).replace(".", ","), (x, y), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points",
                ha="center", color="white", fontweight="bold",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.25", fc=colour, ec="none"))


quarters = [f"Tw. {q} {y}" for y in (2023, 2024, 2025) for q in ("I", "II", "III", "IV")] + ["Tw. I 2026", "Tw. II 2026"]
ratio = np.array([30.1, 29.4, 28.9, 29.6, 29.3, 29.8, 31.0, 30.4, 30.6, 30.5, 29.8, 30.0, 29.7, 30.7])
countries = ["Indonesia", "India", "Malaysia", "Thailand", "Filipina", "Tiongkok", "AS", "Jepang"]
shares = np.array([30.7, 20.0, 71.6, 35.8, 31.6, 12.2, 95.9, 103.0])
years = np.arange(2010, 2027)
tier1 = np.array([17, 13, 17, 18, 18, 31, 35, 26, 25, 27, 28, 22, 17, 18, 19, 15, 14])
tier2 = np.array([21, 23, 36, 39, 33, 63, 62, 54, 54, 54, 53, 41, 40, 39, 38, 36, 37])
```

## Slide teks: ukuran normal

- Paling banyak lima butir (enam dengan `{.normal}`), masing-masing paling banyak dua baris.
- Satu slide membawa satu pesan; judul slide menyatakan pesan itu.
- Jika isi tidak muat, pecah menjadi dua slide.
- Huruf isi Calibri 16pt di slide tanpa gambar, 14pt di slide bergambar; judul 18pt Arial tebal.

::: {.takeaway}
Kotak takeaway memuat satu pesan utama slide, paling banyak dua baris.
:::

## Judul aksi boleh dua baris: rasio *debt service* stabil, namun utang jangka pendek terhadap cadangan devisa naik {.small}

- Judul slide adalah kalimat pesan, seperti di deck DEN, paling banyak dua baris.
- Judul tiga baris otomatis mengecil ke 16pt; lebih baik dipersingkat.
- Kata *miring*, **tebal** dan `kode` di judul tetap berjarak normal.
- `.small` memuat sampai delapan butir pada 12pt.

## Persamaan

Model gravitasi yang dilinearkan:

$$
y_{ij} = \beta_0 + \beta_1 Dist_{ij} + \beta_2 gdp_i + \varepsilon_{ij}
$$

dengan $y_{ij}$ log ekspor dari negara asal $i$ ke negara tujuan $j$, $Dist_{ij}$ log jarak antara $i$ dan $j$, $gdp_i$ log PDB negara $i$, dan $\varepsilon_{ij}$ galat.

::: {.takeaway}
Setiap variabel dan parameter didefinisikan tepat di bawah persamaannya.
:::

## Dua grafik berjudul, dengan catatan dan sumber

:::: {.cols height="100%"}

::: {.plain title="Rasio ULN terhadap PDB Indonesia" unit="Persen"}
```{python}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.6
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.6))
ax.plot(range(len(ratio)), ratio, color=den.AMBER_GOLD, lw=2.5)
end_label(ax, len(ratio) - 1, ratio[-1], den.AMBER_GOLD)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(quarters)), quarters, rotation=90)
ax.set_ylim(27.5, 31.5)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::

::: {.plain title="Perbandingan rasio ULN/PDB, Tw. II/2026" unit="Persen"}
```{python}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.6
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.6))
colours = [den.CLAY] + [den.AMBER_GOLD] * (len(countries) - 1)
ax.bar(countries, shares, color=colours, width=0.7)
for i, (v, c) in enumerate(zip(shares, colours)):
    end_label(ax, i, v, c)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(countries)), countries, rotation=90)
ax.set_ylim(0, 120)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::

## Grafik dan card berikon

:::: {.cols rows="2.6,1" height="100%"}

::: {.plain title="*Debt Servicing Ratio* Tier-1 dan Tier-2" unit="persen"}
```{python}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.3
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.3))
ax.bar(years - 0.2, tier1, width=0.4, color=den.AMBER_GOLD, label="DSR Tier-1")
ax.bar(years + 0.2, tier2, width=0.4, color=den.CLAY, label="DSR Tier-2")
ax.set_xticks(years, [str(y) for y in years[:-1]] + ["2Q26"], rotation=90)
ax.legend(loc="upper center", ncol=2, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.15))
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::

::: {.plain title="Rasio ULN terhadap PDB Indonesia" unit="persen"}
```{python}
#| fig-width: 6

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.3))
ax.plot(range(len(ratio)), ratio, color=den.CLAY, lw=2.5)
end_label(ax, len(ratio) - 1, ratio[-1], den.CLAY)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(quarters)), quarters, rotation=90)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Gambar penuh dari code chunk

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 4.8))
ax.plot(years, tier2, color=den.CLAY, lw=2.5, label="DSR Tier-2")
ax.plot(years, tier1, color=den.AMBER_GOLD, lw=2.5, label="DSR Tier-1")
end_label(ax, years[-1], tier2[-1], den.CLAY, "{:.0f}")
end_label(ax, years[-1], tier1[-1], den.AMBER_GOLD, "{:.0f}")
ax.set_ylabel("Persen")
ax.legend(loc="upper left", ncol=2)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

::: {.note}
Garis menunjukkan rasio pembayaran utang (sumbu-y) per tahun (sumbu-x).
:::

## Gambar dari berkas: `.fig-half`

![](logo.png){.fig-half}

Slot `.fig-half` menyisakan ruang untuk teks dan kotak takeaway di slide yang sama.

::: {.takeaway}
Gunakan `.fig-full` bila gambar adalah isi slide, `.fig-half` bila gambar berbagi tempat dengan teks.
